takeaways: The 51.5-point margin was larger than either team's main lineup leak, so the matchup was decided more by raw scoring than one obvious swap.
The clearest unit edge was total RB output: Joe’s Cocksmithing Station by 34.9 points.
Against projection, Joe’s Cocksmithing Station finished +36.3 while Nacua-Cola finished -24.0.
The biggest started performance was Bijan Robinson for Joe’s Cocksmithing Station at 35.3 points.
